title: Phudagi language
extract: The Phudagi language, also known as Vadvali, is a language or dialect of the Marathi–Konkani group. This language is spoken by Panchkalshi and Chaukalshi communities residing in Palghar, Vasai localities. It is considered an endangered language, due to its decreased use as a first language for young people.
